verdict.rationale: Choosing a data-storage region is a fair question for a cloud meeting-transcription SaaS, but the evidence pack never documents region or residency selection. Exporting to a customer's own S3 bucket or Google Drive is an export/sync feature, not control over where Otter stores data, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
